decisions.reason: Paul lists Israel's gifts in 9:4-5: adoption, glory, covenants, law, worship, promises. The calling is God's choice of Israel, the "election" of verse 28.

decisions.choice: God never changes his mind about
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word with a plain phrase.

decisions.choice: "후회함이 없다" (L); "결코 거두어들이지 않으시다" (B); "결코 마음을 바꾸지 않으시다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means not regretted, never taken back (meaning decision). Literal keeps the picture of regret; Balanced and Readable say what it means for the gifts.

decisions.choice: "ân tứ" (L, B); "món quà" (R)
decisions.reason: The gifts are the privileges God gave Israel (m2, 9:4-5), the word kept as "ân tứ" since 1:11, with "món quà" at Readable.

decisions.choice: no span for "his mind"
decisions.reason: Portuguese says "mudar de ideia" without a possessive, so Readable has one deity_pronoun span fewer than the English "his mind".

decisions.choice: የማይጸጸትባቸው (not regretted)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture, gifts God will never regret giving; Balanced says they are never taken back.

source.text: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ποτε ἠπειθήσατε τῷ θεῷ, νῦν δὲ ἠλεήθητε τῇ τούτων ἀπειθείᾳ, οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι νῦν ἠπείθησαν τῷ ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ νῦν ἐλεηθῶσιν·

records.literal_gloss: Just as for you once disobeyed the God, now but received mercy by the of these disobedience, \v 31 so also these now disobeyed the your mercy so that also they now may receive mercy;

en.L: For just as you once were disobedient to God but now have received mercy because of their disobedience, \v 31 so these also have now been disobedient, for the mercy [shown] to you, so that they too may now receive mercy.
en.B: Once you were disobedient to God, but now you have been shown mercy because of their disobedience. \v 31 In the same way they have now been disobedient, so that by the mercy God has shown you, they too may now be shown mercy.
en.R: At one time you did not obey God. But now God has shown you mercy, because the people of Israel did not obey. \v 31 In the same way, they have now refused to obey, so that they too may now receive mercy because of the mercy God has shown you.

es.L: Porque así como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en otro tiempo {{plural_you:desobedecieron|desobedecisteis}} a Dios, pero ahora {{plural_you:han|habéis}} recibido misericordia por la desobediencia de ellos, \v 31 así también estos ahora han desobedecido, por la misericordia [mostrada] a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, para que también ellos ahora reciban misericordia.
es.B: En otro tiempo {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} desobedientes a Dios, pero ahora {{plural_you:han|habéis}} alcanzado misericordia a causa de la desobediencia de ellos. \v 31 Del mismo modo, ellos ahora han sido desobedientes, para que, por la misericordia que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha mostrado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, también ellos alcancen ahora misericordia.
es.R: En otro tiempo {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:obedecían|obedecíais}} a Dios. Pero ahora Dios ha tenido misericordia de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque el pueblo de Israel no obedeció. \v 31 Del mismo modo, ellos ahora se han negado a obedecer, para que también ellos reciban ahora misericordia gracias a la misericordia que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha mostrado.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile ninyi hapo zamani mlikuwa wasiomtii Mungu, lakini sasa mmerehemiwa kwa sababu ya kutotii kwao, \v 31 vivyo hivyo hawa nao sasa wamekuwa wasiotii, kwa ajili ya rehema [mliyoonyeshwa] ninyi, ili wao pia sasa warehemiwe.
sw.B: Hapo zamani mlikuwa wasiomtii Mungu, lakini sasa mmeonyeshwa rehema kwa sababu ya kutotii kwao. \v 31 Vivyo hivyo, wao sasa wamekuwa wasiotii, ili kwa rehema ambayo Mungu amewaonyesha ninyi, wao pia sasa waonyeshwe rehema.
sw.R: Wakati fulani ninyi hamkumtii Mungu. Lakini sasa Mungu amewaonyesha rehema, kwa sababu watu wa Israeli hawakutii. \v 31 Vivyo hivyo, wao sasa wamekataa kutii, ili wao pia sasa wapokee rehema kwa sababu ya rehema ambayo Mungu amewaonyesha ninyi.

fr.L: Car, de même que vous, vous avez autrefois désobéi à Dieu, mais que maintenant vous avez obtenu miséricorde par leur désobéissance, \v 31 de même eux aussi ont maintenant désobéi, pour la miséricorde [faite] à vous, afin qu’eux aussi obtiennent maintenant miséricorde.
fr.B: Autrefois, vous avez désobéi à Dieu, mais maintenant vous avez obtenu miséricorde grâce à leur désobéissance. \v 31 De même, eux aussi ont maintenant désobéi, afin que, par la miséricorde que Dieu vous a faite, ils obtiennent eux aussi maintenant miséricorde.
fr.R: Autrefois, vous n’obéissiez pas à Dieu. Mais maintenant, Dieu a eu pitié de vous, parce que le peuple d’Israël n’a pas obéi. \v 31 De la même façon, ils ont maintenant refusé d’obéir, pour qu’eux aussi reçoivent maintenant la miséricorde, grâce à la miséricorde que Dieu vous a montrée.

ko.L: 여러분이 전에는 하나님께 순종하지 않았으나 이제는 이들의 불순종 때문에 자비를 입은 것처럼, \v 31 이와 같이 이들도 이제 순종하지 않았으니, 이는 여러분에게 [베푸신] 자비로 이들도 이제 자비를 입게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 전에 하나님께 순종하지 않았지만, 이제는 이스라엘의 불순종 때문에 자비를 입었습니다. \v 31 이와 같이 이스라엘도 지금은 순종하지 않고 있지만, 그것은 하나님께서 여러분에게 베푸신 자비를 통해 그들도 이제 자비를 입게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 한때 하나님께 순종하지 않았습니다. 그러나 이스라엘 백성이 순종하지 않았기 때문에, 이제 하나님께서 여러분에게 자비를 베푸셨습니다. \v 31 이와 같이 이스라엘 백성도 지금은 순종하기를 거부하고 있습니다. 그것은 하나님께서 여러분에게 베푸신 자비 때문에 그들도 이제 자비를 입게 하시려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì như anh chị em trước kia đã không vâng phục Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng nay đã nhận được sự thương xót vì sự không vâng phục của họ, \v 31 thì cũng vậy, nay họ đã không vâng phục, vì sự thương xót [dành cho] anh chị em, để chính họ cũng nay được thương xót.
vi.B: Trước kia anh chị em đã không vâng phục Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng nay anh chị em đã được thương xót vì sự không vâng phục của họ. \v 31 Cũng vậy, nay họ đã không vâng phục, để nhờ sự thương xót Đức Chúa Trời đã tỏ ra cho anh chị em, chính họ cũng nay được thương xót.
vi.R: Có một thời anh chị em đã không vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời. Nhưng nay Đức Chúa Trời đã thương xót anh chị em, vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã không vâng lời. \v 31 Cũng vậy, nay họ đã không chịu vâng lời, để chính họ cũng nay được thương xót nhờ sự thương xót Đức Chúa Trời đã tỏ ra cho anh chị em.

pt.L: Pois, assim como vocês outrora desobedeceram a Deus, mas agora receberam misericórdia por causa da desobediência destes, \v 31 assim também estes agora desobedeceram, pela misericórdia [mostrada] a vocês, para que também eles agora recebam misericórdia.
pt.B: Vocês antes eram desobedientes a Deus, mas agora receberam misericórdia por causa da desobediência deles. \v 31 Do mesmo modo, eles agora se tornaram desobedientes, para que, pela misericórdia que Deus mostrou a vocês, também eles agora recebam misericórdia.
pt.R: Antes vocês não obedeciam a Deus. Mas agora Deus teve misericórdia de vocês, porque o povo de Israel não obedeceu. \v 31 Do mesmo modo, eles agora se recusaram a obedecer, para que também recebam misericórdia agora, por causa da misericórdia que Deus mostrou a vocês.

am.L: እናንተ ቀድሞ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዳልታዘዛችሁ፣ አሁን ግን በእነርሱ አለመታዘዝ ምሕረትን እንዳገኛችሁ፣ \v 31 እንዲሁ እነዚህም ደግሞ አሁን አልታዘዙም፤ ይኸውም ለእናንተ [በተደረገው] ምሕረት እነርሱም ደግሞ አሁን ምሕረትን እንዲያገኙ ነው።
am.B: እናንተ በአንድ ወቅት ለእግዚአብሔር የማትታዘዙ ነበራችሁ፤ አሁን ግን በእነርሱ አለመታዘዝ ምክንያት ምሕረት ተደረገላችሁ። \v 31 እንዲሁም እነርሱ አሁን አልታዘዙም፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር ለእናንተ ባደረገው ምሕረት እነርሱም ደግሞ አሁን ምሕረት እንዲደረግላቸው ነው።
am.R: ቀድሞ እናንተ ለእግዚአብሔር አልታዘዛችሁም ነበር። አሁን ግን የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ስላልታዘዙ እግዚአብሔር ምሕረት አደረገላችሁ። \v 31 እንዲሁም እነርሱ አሁን ለመታዘዝ እምቢ ብለዋል፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር ለእናንተ ባደረገው ምሕረት ምክንያት እነርሱም ደግሞ አሁን ምሕረትን እንዲያገኙ ነው።

decisions.choice: disobey: refuse to obey, especially by not believing
decisions.reason: In Romans this verb is used of refusing the gospel (10:21, 15:31), so it includes unbelief.

decisions.choice: by the mercy shown to you goes with what follows: so that, through the mercy shown to you, they too may receive mercy
alternatives: it goes with what comes before: they have been disobedient because of the mercy shown to you
decisions.reason: In Greek the phrase stands before "so that", which suggests the second reading and matches "because of their disobedience" in verse 30. But Paul has already said that mercy to the Gentiles is meant to make Israel jealous and so bring them to mercy (verses 11 and 14), which fits the first. The Literal level keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: they too may now receive mercy
alternatives: some manuscripts leave out the second "now"
a few manuscripts read "later" in its place
decisions.reason: Early manuscripts are divided over the second "now"; the SBLGNT includes it. With it, Paul sees Israel's mercy as part of the present time. Reviewers must check the details against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: In the same way
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable split the long comparison into two sentences and join them with "In the same way".

decisions.choice: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable names who "these" are.

decisions.choice: the mercy God has shown you
decisions.reason: "Your mercy" means the mercy shown to you, not mercy you show; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: kutotii (not obeying)
decisions.reason: "Kuasi" is open rebellion; the Greek verb is refusing to obey, which in Romans includes refusing to believe (m1). "Kutotii" says that without adding revolt. Mercy is "rehema" in verses 30-32.

decisions.choice: obtenir miséricorde, la miséricorde (L, B); avoir pitié, la miséricorde (R), as in 9:15
decisions.reason: Paul uses the verb and the noun for mercy three times in two verses, and the argument turns on them. Literal and Balanced keep "miséricorde" each time so the repetition shows; Readable uses the plain verb "avoir pitié" once and keeps the noun.

decisions.choice: "자비" at every level for mercy, "자비를 입다" for receiving it, here and in verse 32
decisions.reason: "자비" is the letter's word for God's mercy (9:16, 9:18, 9:23); the older church word "긍휼" is avoided.

decisions.choice: "순종하지 않다", "불순종" at every level
decisions.reason: To disobey here is to refuse to obey, especially by not believing (meaning decision); the same verb as at 10:21.

decisions.choice: "không vâng phục" (L, B); "không vâng lời" (R) (also 11:32; 10:21)
decisions.reason: To disobey is to refuse to obey, especially by not believing (m1). "Không vâng phục" is the opposite of the "vâng phục" of 1:5 and 10:16; Readable says "vâng lời", the everyday word. "Thương xót" is kept for mercy, as in 9:15.

source.text: συνέκλεισεν γὰρ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς πάντας εἰς ἀπείθειαν ἵνα τοὺς πάντας ἐλεήσῃ.

records.literal_gloss: Shut up together for the God the all into disobedience so that the all he may have mercy on.

en.L: For God has shut up all in disobedience, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may have mercy on all.
en.B: For God has locked everyone up together in disobedience, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may show mercy to everyone.
en.R: God has put everyone in the prison of disobedience, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can show mercy to everyone.

es.L: Porque Dios encerró a todos en desobediencia, para tener misericordia de todos.
es.B: Porque Dios ha encerrado a todos juntos en la desobediencia, para mostrar misericordia a todos.
es.R: Dios ha puesto a todos en la cárcel de la desobediencia, para poder mostrar misericordia a todos.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu amewafungia wote katika kutotii, ili wote awarehemu.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu amewafungia watu wote pamoja ndani ya kutotii, ili apate kuwaonyesha wote rehema.
sw.R: Mungu amewaweka watu wote katika gereza la kutotii, ili aweze kuwaonyesha wote rehema.

fr.L: Car Dieu a enfermé tous dans [la] désobéissance, afin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse miséricorde à tous.
fr.B: Car Dieu a enfermé tout le monde ensemble dans la désobéissance, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} puisse faire miséricorde à tout le monde.
fr.R: Dieu a mis tout le monde dans la prison de la désobéissance, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} puisse avoir pitié de tout le monde.

ko.L: 하나님께서 모든 사람을 불순종 가운데 가두어 두신 것은 모든 사람에게 자비를 베푸시려는 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 모든 사람을 불순종 안에 함께 가두어 두셨습니다. 그것은 모든 사람에게 자비를 베푸시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 모든 사람을 불순종이라는 감옥에 가두셨습니다. 그것은 모든 사람에게 자비를 베푸실 수 있게 하시려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã giam mọi người trong sự không vâng phục, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót mọi người.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã nhốt chung mọi người trong sự không vâng phục, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể tỏ lòng thương xót với mọi người.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã để mọi người bị giam trong ngục của sự không vâng lời, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể tỏ lòng thương xót với mọi người.

pt.L: Pois Deus encerrou todos na desobediência, para ter misericórdia de todos.
pt.B: Pois Deus prendeu todos juntos na desobediência, para mostrar misericórdia a todos.
pt.R: Deus colocou todos na prisão da desobediência, para poder ter misericórdia de todos.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን እንዲምር ሁሉን በአለመታዘዝ ውስጥ በአንድነት ዘግቷልና።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ለሁሉም ምሕረት ያደርግ ዘንድ ሁሉንም በአንድነት በአለመታዘዝ ውስጥ ቆልፎ አስቀምጧቸዋልና።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉንም ሰው በአለመታዘዝ እስር ቤት ውስጥ አስገብቷል፤ ይህም ለሁሉም ምሕረት ማድረግ እንዲችል ነው።

decisions.choice: shut up: imprison, lock in
decisions.reason: The verb means to shut in on all sides, like fish in a net or prisoners in a cell. Paul uses it the same way in Galatians 3:22.

decisions.choice: all: both Jews and Gentiles, all people without distinction
alternatives: every individual, all of whom will finally receive mercy
decisions.reason: Verses 30-31 have spoken of two groups, Gentiles and Jews, both disobedient and both shown mercy. The point is that no one is shown mercy on any other basis. Some read "all" as a promise that every person will be saved; elsewhere Romans speaks of judgment for those who refuse God (2:5-8).

decisions.choice: so that: God's purpose
decisions.reason: The aim of shutting everyone up in disobedience is mercy: no one can come to God except by mercy.

decisions.choice: put everyone in the prison of disobedience
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of the verb and makes it plain.

decisions.choice: "모든 사람" with no gender span, as at 5:18
decisions.reason: "사람" already includes men and women; the meaning decision says "all" is Jews and Gentiles alike.

decisions.choice: para ter misericórdia (no pronoun for God)
decisions.reason: With the same subject in both clauses Portuguese uses the infinitive, so there is no pronoun and no deity_pronoun span where the English has "he".

source.text: Ὦ βάθος πλούτου καὶ σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως θεοῦ· ὡς ἀνεξεραύνητα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστοι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: O depth of riches and of wisdom and of knowledge of God; how unsearchable the judgments of him and untraceable the ways of him.

en.L: O [the] depth of [the] riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments and untraceable {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways!
en.B: How deep are the riches and the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How impossible to search out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments, and how impossible to trace {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways!
en.R: How great God's riches are! How deep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom and knowledge are! No one can fully understand {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decisions. No one can trace the paths {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes.

es.L: ¡Oh profundidad de [las] riquezas y de [la] sabiduría y del conocimiento de Dios! ¡Cuán inescrutables [son] {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios e imposibles de rastrear {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos!
es.B: ¡Qué profundas son las riquezas y la sabiduría y el conocimiento de Dios! ¡Qué imposible es investigar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios y seguir el rastro de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos!
es.R: ¡Qué grandes son las riquezas de Dios! ¡Qué profundos son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} conocimiento! Nadie puede entender del todo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decisiones. Nadie puede seguir los caminos por donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} va.

sw.L: Ee kina cha utajiri na hekima na maarifa ya Mungu! Jinsi gani hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} hazichunguziki, na njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} hazifuatiliki!
sw.B: Utajiri na hekima na maarifa ya Mungu ni ya kina kirefu mno! Hakuna awezaye kuzichunguza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, wala kuzifuatilia njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}!
sw.R: Utajiri wa Mungu ni mkubwa kiasi gani! Hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na maarifa {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni ya kina kirefu mno! Hakuna mtu anayeweza kuelewa kikamilifu maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Hakuna anayeweza kufuatilia njia anazopita.

fr.L: Ô profondeur de [la] richesse et de [la] sagesse et de [la] connaissance de Dieu ! Combien {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements [sont] insondables, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies impossibles à suivre à la trace !
fr.B: Que la richesse, la sagesse et la connaissance de Dieu sont profondes ! Qu’il est impossible de sonder {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements, et impossible de suivre la trace de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins !
fr.R: Que les richesses de Dieu sont grandes ! Que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} connaissance sont profondes ! Personne ne peut comprendre complètement {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions. Personne ne peut suivre la trace des chemins qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend.

ko.L: 오, 하나님의 부요함과 지혜와 지식은 얼마나 깊습니까! 그분의 판단들은 얼마나 헤아릴 수 없으며, 그분의 길들은 얼마나 찾을 수 없습니까!
ko.B: 하나님의 부요하심과 지혜와 지식은 얼마나 깊습니까! 그분의 판단은 아무도 헤아릴 수 없고, 그분의 길은 아무도 더듬어 찾을 수 없습니다!
ko.R: 하나님의 부요하심은 얼마나 큽니까! 그분의 지혜와 지식은 얼마나 깊습니까! 그분이 내리시는 결정을 누구도 다 이해할 수 없습니다. 그분이 가시는 길을 누구도 따라가 찾아낼 수 없습니다.

vi.L: Ôi, sâu thẳm thay sự giàu có, sự khôn ngoan và tri thức của Đức Chúa Trời! Các phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật không thể dò xét, và các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật không thể truy tìm!
vi.B: Sự giàu có, sự khôn ngoan và tri thức của Đức Chúa Trời sâu thẳm biết bao! Những phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không ai dò thấu được, và đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không ai lần theo được!
vi.R: Sự giàu có của Đức Chúa Trời lớn lao biết bao! Sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu xa biết bao! Không ai có thể hiểu thấu hết những quyết định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không ai có thể lần theo những con đường {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi.

pt.L: Ó profundidade [da] riqueza, e da sabedoria, e do conhecimento de Deus! Como [são] impossíveis de sondar os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} juízos, e de rastrear os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos!
pt.B: Como são profundas a riqueza, a sabedoria e o conhecimento de Deus! Ninguém consegue investigar os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} juízos, ninguém consegue seguir o rastro dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos!
pt.R: Como são grandes as riquezas de Deus! Como são profundos a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} conhecimento! Ninguém consegue entender por completo as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} decisões. Ninguém consegue seguir os caminhos por onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} anda.

am.L: ኦ የእግዚአብሔር የብልጽግናና የጥበብ የእውቀትም ጥልቀት! ፍርዶቹ እንዴት የማይመረመሩ፣ መንገዶቹም እንዴት የማይደረስባቸው [ናቸው]!
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ብልጽግና፣ ጥበብና እውቀት እንዴት ጥልቅ ነው! ፍርዶቹን መመርመር፣ መንገዶቹንም መከታተል እንዴት የማይቻል ነው!
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ብልጽግና እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! ጥበቡና እውቀቱ እንዴት ጥልቅ ነው! ውሳኔዎቹን ማንም ሙሉ በሙሉ ሊረዳ አይችልም። የሚሄድባቸውንም መንገዶች ማንም ሊከታተል አይችልም።

decisions.choice: three things are deep: God's riches, God's wisdom and God's knowledge
alternatives: the depth of the riches of God's wisdom and knowledge
decisions.reason: The three nouns are joined by "and ... and", so most likely each is its own subject of praise. The riches would be the riches of God's mercy (2:4, 9:23, 10:12). The other reading takes riches as describing the wisdom and knowledge.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's decisions
decisions.reason: The word here means the decisions God makes in governing the world and history, as the chapter has described them.

decisions.choice: Job 11:7-8 and Isaiah 55:8-9
decisions.reason: Paul's praise echoes the Old Testament theme that no one can search out the depths of God (Job 11:7-8) or match his thoughts and ways (Isaiah 55:8-9).

decisions.choice: No one can trace the paths he takes
decisions.reason: Readable turns the adjective into a plain sentence; the word means a track that cannot be followed.

decisions.choice: the exclamations in 합쇼체 ("얼마나 깊습니까!")
decisions.reason: Paul's praise stays in the letter's 합쇼체; "-도다" is archaic and "-지요" belongs to 해요체.

decisions.choice: "판단" (L, B); "결정" (R)
decisions.reason: The judgments are God's decisions (meaning decision), not his judgment of sinners, so "심판" (2:2-5) is not used.

decisions.choice: "sâu thẳm" said of all three nouns (L, B)
alternatives: "sự giàu có của sự khôn ngoan"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads three things as deep: riches, wisdom and knowledge, with a footnote for "riches of wisdom and knowledge". Vietnamese lists the three nouns side by side so that "sâu thẳm" governs each. "Tri thức" is the word kept for knowledge in 2:20.

decisions.choice: impossíveis de sondar ... de rastrear (L); Ninguém consegue investigar ... seguir o rastro (B)
decisions.reason: The two adjectives are rare learned words in Portuguese; Literal and Balanced say what they mean (a depth no one can search, a track no one can follow), as the English does, and keep clear of the familiar wording of other versions.

decisions.choice: የብልጽግናና የጥበብ የእውቀትም ጥልቀት (L); ብልጽግና፣ ጥበብና እውቀት (B)
alternatives: the familiar 1962 wording of this verse
decisions.reason: The verse is well known in an older wording; it is drafted afresh from the Greek, with ብልጽግና for 'riches' as in 11:12, and the three things that are deep kept apart (meaning note m1).

source.text: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν κυρίου;

records.literal_gloss: Who for has known mind of Lord?

en.L: For "who has known [the] mind of [the] Lord?"
en.B: For "who has known the mind of the Lord?"
en.R: As Scripture says, "Who has ever known what the Lord is thinking?"

es.L: Porque «¿quién conoció [la] mente del Señor?»
es.B: Porque «¿quién ha conocido la mente del Señor?»
es.R: Como dice la Escritura: «¿Quién ha sabido jamás lo que piensa el Señor?»

sw.L: Kwa maana "nani ameijua akili ya Bwana?"
sw.B: Kwa maana "ni nani amepata kuijua akili ya Bwana?"
sw.R: Kama Maandiko yanavyosema: "Ni nani amewahi kujua mawazo ya Bwana?"

fr.L: Car « qui a connu [la] pensée du Seigneur ? »
fr.B: Car « qui a connu la pensée du Seigneur ? »
fr.R: Comme le dit l’Écriture : « Qui a jamais su ce que le Seigneur pense ? »

ko.L: "누가 주의 마음을 알았느냐?"
ko.B: "누가 주님의 마음을 알았느냐?"
ko.R: 성경에 이렇게 기록되어 있습니다. "누가 주님의 생각을 알 수 있었느냐?"

vi.L: Vì "ai đã biết tâm trí của Chúa?"
vi.B: Vì "ai đã biết được ý tưởng của Chúa?"
vi.R: Như Kinh Thánh chép: "Có ai từng biết Chúa đang nghĩ gì không?"

pt.L: Pois "quem conheceu [a] mente do Senhor?"
pt.B: Pois "quem conheceu a mente do Senhor?"
pt.R: Como diz a Escritura: "Quem já soube o que o Senhor está pensando?"

am.L: ምክንያቱም «የጌታን አእምሮ ማን አወቀ?»
am.B: ምክንያቱም «የጌታን ሐሳብ ያወቀ ማን ነው?»
am.R: መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ እንደሚለው፣ «ጌታ የሚያስበውን ያወቀ ማን አለ?»

decisions.choice: Isaiah 40:13
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the old Greek translation of Isaiah 40:13, as he does in 1 Corinthians 2:16. The Hebrew reads "Who has measured the Spirit of the LORD?", with the divine name; the Greek has "Lord". The quotation continues in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: mind: God's thoughts and purposes
decisions.reason: The question means that no one knows God's plans unless he reveals them.

decisions.choice: As Scripture says
decisions.reason: Readable tells the reader that a quotation follows, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "주" (L); "주님" (B, R), with no divine_name span; the quotation in 해라체
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios, as in the quotations at 9:28 and 10:13; Scripture is quoted in 해라체 through the letter.

decisions.choice: "Chúa", not "CHÚA"
decisions.reason: Isaiah has the divine name, but the Greek quotation has "Lord". As in 9:28 and 10:13, the New Testament wording is followed with "Chúa".

source.text: ἢ τίς σύμβουλος αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο;

records.literal_gloss: Or who counselor of him has become?

en.L: "Or who has become {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} counselor?"
en.B: "Or who has been {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} counselor?"
en.R: "Or who has ever given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} advice?"

es.L: «¿O quién llegó a ser {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} consejero?»
es.B: «¿O quién ha sido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} consejero?»
es.R: «¿O quién {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado alguna vez un consejo?»

sw.L: "Au ni nani aliyekuwa mshauri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}?"
sw.B: "Au ni nani amekuwa mshauri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}?"
sw.R: "Au ni nani amewahi kumpa ushauri?"

fr.L: « Ou qui est devenu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} conseiller ? »
fr.B: « Ou qui a été {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} conseiller ? »
fr.R: « Ou qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a jamais donné un conseil ? »

ko.L: "또 누가 그분의 조언자가 되었느냐?"
ko.B: "누가 그분의 조언자가 되었느냐?"
ko.R: "누가 그분에게 조언을 해 드린 적이 있느냐?"

vi.L: "Hoặc ai đã trở thành cố vấn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.B: "Hay ai đã từng làm cố vấn cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.R: "Hay có ai từng khuyên bảo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không?"

pt.L: "Ou quem se tornou {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} conselheiro?"
pt.B: "Ou quem foi o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} conselheiro?"
pt.R: "Ou quem já deu conselhos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?"

am.L: «ወይስ አማካሪው የሆነ ማን ነው?»
am.B: «ወይስ አማካሪው የነበረ ማን ነው?»
am.R: «ወይስ እርሱን የመከረ ማን አለ?»

decisions.choice: Isaiah 40:13, continued
decisions.reason: This is the second line of Isaiah 40:13; the Hebrew asks who has instructed the LORD as his counselor.

decisions.choice: given him advice
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain verb.

source.text: ἢ τίς προέδωκεν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him?

en.L: "Or who has first given to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and it will be repaid to him?"
en.B: "Or who has given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} anything first and must be paid back?"
en.R: "Has anyone ever given God a gift, so that God must pay them back?"

es.L: «¿O quién {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado primero, y le será devuelto?»
es.B: «¿O quién {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado algo primero, para que tenga que devolvérselo?»
es.R: «¿Alguien ha hecho alguna vez un regalo a Dios, de modo que Dios tenga que pagárselo?»

sw.L: "Au ni nani aliyempa kwanza, naye atalipwa?"
sw.B: "Au ni nani aliyempa kitu kwanza, hata alazimike kumlipa?"
sw.R: "Je, kuna mtu aliyewahi kumpa Mungu zawadi, hata Mungu alazimike kumlipa?"

fr.L: « Ou qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné le premier, pour qu’on doive le lui rendre ? »
fr.B: « Ou qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné quelque chose en premier, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} doive le lui rendre ? »
fr.R: « Quelqu’un a-t-il jamais fait un cadeau à Dieu, pour que Dieu doive le lui rendre ? »

ko.L: "또 누가 먼저 그분께 드려서 그가 [다시] 갚음을 받겠느냐?"
ko.B: "누가 먼저 그분께 무엇을 드려서 그분께 되돌려 받아야 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: "누가 하나님께 먼저 선물을 드려서, 하나님께서 그 사람에게 갚아 주셔야 하겠느냐?"

vi.L: "Hoặc ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước, và sẽ được đền trả lại?"
vi.B: "Hay ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì trước, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải trả lại cho người ấy?"
vi.R: "Có ai từng tặng Đức Chúa Trời một món quà, để Đức Chúa Trời phải đền đáp lại cho họ không?"

pt.L: "Ou quem primeiro {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu, e lhe será retribuído?"
pt.B: "Ou quem {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu alguma coisa primeiro, para ter de ser pago de volta?"
pt.R: "Alguém já deu um presente a Deus, para que Deus tenha de lhe pagar de volta?"

am.L: «ወይስ አስቀድሞ ለእርሱ የሰጠና ብድራት የሚመለስለት ማን ነው?»
am.B: «ወይስ አስቀድሞ አንዳች ሰጥቶት ብድሩ የሚከፈለው ማን ነው?»
am.R: «እግዚአብሔር መልሶ እንዲከፍለው ለእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ የሰጠ ማን አለ?»

decisions.reason: The words are close to the Hebrew of Job 41:11 (41:3 in Hebrew), where God says, "Who has first given to me, that I should repay him?" The old Greek translation of that verse is quite different. In Job the divine name is not in this line.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no one"
decisions.reason: God owes nothing to anyone; everything he gives is grace (4:4, 11:6).

decisions.choice: God ... God must pay them back
alternatives: him ... it will be repaid to him
decisions.reason: Readable names God for both pronouns. The giver is "them", an English pronoun for one person of either sex.

decisions.choice: "그분께" with the honorific for God; "그" (L) for the giver
decisions.reason: In this quotation the speaker is not God, so God is spoken of with the honorific as in the letter; the human giver takes the plain "그".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu ... lhe será retribuído
alternatives: deu a ele ... será retribuído a ele
decisions.reason: Both clauses have "to him", but only the first is God; the second is the giver, so only the first "lhe" takes the deity_pronoun span, as in the English.

source.text: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα· αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: Because from him and through him and to him the all things; to him the glory to the ages, amen.

en.L: For from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [are] all things. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [be] the glory forever. Amen.
en.B: For all things are from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be glory forever! Amen.
en.R: Everything comes from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Everything exists through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Let all glory be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} forever! Amen.

pt.R: Tudo vem {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Tudo existe por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Que toda a glória seja {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} para sempre! Amém.

decisions.choice: from him, through him, to him: God is the source, the means and the goal of all things
decisions.reason: The three prepositions say that all things come from God, exist by his working, and lead back to him (compare 1 Corinthians 8:6).

decisions.choice: to him be the glory: a wish or prayer
alternatives: to him is the glory: a statement
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. A doxology like this is normally a prayer that God will be glorified, as in 16:27 and Galatians 1:5.

decisions.choice: to the ages: forever
decisions.reason: "To the ages" is a Greek way of saying "forever".

decisions.choice: for him
decisions.reason: English says "for him" for the goal or purpose of something.

decisions.choice: Let all glory be his
decisions.reason: Readable puts the prayer in plain words, as the meaning decision describes it.

decisions.choice: "그분께로 [돌아가다]" (L); "그분을 위해 있다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God is the source, the means and the goal of all things (meaning decision). Literal keeps the direction "to him"; Balanced and Readable say the goal with "위해", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "hướng về Ngài" (L); "vì Ngài" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God is the source, the means and the goal of all things (m1). Literal keeps the direction of "to him"; Balanced and Readable say "vì Ngài" (for him), as the English does. "A-men" as in 1:25.

decisions.choice: vêm ... existem ... são
alternatives: todas as coisas são dele, por ele e para ele
decisions.reason: Portuguese needs a verb for each preposition to read naturally ("vêm de", "existem por meio de", "são para"); the three verbs follow the meaning decision on source, means and goal.

decisions.choice: እስከ ዘመናት (to the ages)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek 'to the ages'; Balanced and Readable say ለዘላለም, the ordinary word for forever.
